title: Anthropic's $60B+ in funding, half of which came just last month, from over 200 investors is now at risk due to the company's contract dispute with the Pentagon (Dan Primack/Axios)
summary: Dan Primack / Axios: Anthropic's $60B+ in funding, half of which came just last month, from over 200 investors is now at risk due to the company's contract dispute with the Pentagon — Anthropic has raised more than $60 billion from over 200 “venture capital” investors, half of which came just last month.
